text:
Carla (PM): quick sync — I want a minimal acceptance checklist for VPC/on-prem private deploy. Field asks: predictable egress IPs, installer offline mode, KMS/HSM integration, upgrade zero-downtime.
Ben (SRE): +1. Need SLA targets and rollback window defined.
Devon (NetOps): On egress IPs — we need NAT/static IP or relay. Customer-managed NAT is common request.
Emily (Eng): For installer, can we add --offline-mode flag and an airgap bundle? simple checksum and signature.
Frank (Field Ops): Customers want a clear upgrade path to avoid rekeying and IP churn. Typical window: <30 mins.
Carla (PM): Draft acceptance checklist in repo? put core items and severity levels.
Ben (SRE): P0: tenant isolation (no cross-tenant db access), P0: egress preservation, P1: kms integration, P1: metrics/telemetry opt-in.
Emily (Eng): Suggest adding config snippet for static egress mapping:
```
network:
  egress:
    mode: static
    ips: ["203.0.113.10"]
```
Devon (NetOps): Also need docs for BGP peers or relay config. Add example commands.
Frank (Field Ops): Add rollback playbook: switch traffic to hosted fallback for 10m, then revert.
Carla (PM): Owner? @Emily to proto, @Devon to write net playbook, @Ben to add SLOs.
Emily (Eng): I can prototype an installer flag, ETA next Wed.
Devon (NetOps): I'll draft BGP & NAT runbook by EOD Friday.
Ben (SRE): I'll propose 99.9% latency/availability targets and a 2-hour escalation window.
Carla (PM): Great — next steps: compile checklist, ship to field for 1 trial customer. If any blockers, ping here. :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: created doc https://redwood.docs/private/tenant-guardrails-draft
Frank (Field Ops): note: include customer communication template for upgrade interruption.
Carla (PM): Added to roadmap item RD-485, planning groom next Tue.
Emily (Eng): quick Q: how strict on key rotation during upgrade? I suggest allow in-place rotation with dual-key acceptance.
Devon (NetOps): dual-key acceptance seems safest.
Carla (PM): ok capture that. Closing sync for now.
